_meta.description: Real Ashby webhook delivery. The body carries NO organization/tenant id — only `action`, the affected resource under `data`, and a delivery id. The tenant is identified by the PER-INSTALL ENDPOINT URL the delivery is POSTed to (`/webhooks/ashby/{installId}`); each tenant's Ashby webhook is configured with a distinct URL + Ashby-Signature secret in Ashby's admin. Verification: `Ashby-Signature: sha256=<hex>` HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body. Doc-derived; ids are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://developers.ashbyhq.com/docs/webhooks (delivery body = {action, data, ...} with NO org id; tenant resolved by the per-install receiving endpoint URL + signing secret; Ashby-Signature = sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body>)

headers.Ashby-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body keyed by this install's signing secret; the contract test recomputes it>
